name: Wallpaper Hub
author: WallPlusCrafts
description: Browse, favourite and apply beautiful wallpapers from Wallhaven — with curated collections, colour search, OS theme sync and one-tap actions.

versionHistory.notes: Complete rewrite. Added colour search, OS theme sync, and curated collections. Wallhaven API updated to v2.
Fixed crash when Wallhaven returns empty results for certain tags.
One-tap apply action. Favourite list now syncs across devices via NovaByte cloud.
Initial public release with basic browse and apply support.
